args.title: Include currency in dedupe key to avoid merging distinct transactions
args.body: File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts. The dedupeKey function builds its key from date, amount and description only, so two transactions that differ solely by currency (e.g. one EUR, one USD) collide and one gets dropped as a duplicate. Update dedupeKey to also include t.currency in the joined key so transactions with different currencies are no longer treated as the same record.
